guideBlocks.title: Supplied variants and controls
items: The archive preserves loose files, ROOT OF GAME FILES and separate Demonic/Jedijosh RGH premade RPFs. Keep the original archive and game files.
Use one menu at a time: the README warns Demonic and Jedijosh together cause problems.
Demonic: RB + right stick click. Jedijosh: RB + D-pad Right. D-pad navigates, A selects and B goes back.
These are source instructions and static file checks; no console installation or execution was tested.
